data.name: Balitansh
data.gender_notes: Balitansh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Balitansh is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'Bal' meaning power and 'Tansh' meaning hands. It represents a person with immense power and authority in their hands. The name Balitansh carries the meaning “Power in Hands” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Balitansh usually hope their child will grow to embody power in hands and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A divine blessing of strength and power in one's hands.
data.etymology: Balitansh belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Power in Hands.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Balitansh total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

Balitansh is a powerful name that embodies the strength and influence of an individual, which is highly valued in Indian society.

The spiritual significance of the name Balitansh lies in its representation of an individual who is not only blessed with power but also uses it wisely and selflessly for the betterment of society and the world around them.
